creating cross-source respondent pools or joins

O1_C10_all35_claim_ledger.update_rule: C4 may update ONLY the exact source x operation cells actually executed or replayed or lawfully inherited. No cell may be promoted by proximity to an executed source.
invariants_preserved: Pre-C4 and post-C4 source-id set equality must be exactly {01..35}.
Every canonical source SHA must remain byte-for-byte identical to the C2-01 ledger.
Every excluded source receives an explicit NONEXECUTED/UNPROVED disposition; none disappears from accounting.
Historical representation PASS/BLOCKED is preserved as history and never promoted into full F1 or F2-F8 proof.
C4 proving-set success may update only exact source x operation obligations actually executed or replayed.
All 280 source x F1-F8 cells remain individually accountable; C4 cannot replace them with an eight-source global green.
X01/X02, authority-blocked surfaces, D01/D02/G01/R05 source scopes, B01/B02, and C2-EPCLASS-PAYLOAD-001 remain separately named.

carried_residuals.note: Blocks class-sensitive epistemic-origin claims. Does not block the physical/empirical proving scope. C4 establishes neither the presence nor the absence of the missing class evidence.

Requires current competent comparable-wave products AND separate positive pair-specific comparison/comparability authority. C4 does not guarantee that pair; the EVS specimens are physical-only and WVS is retained. Completion of C4 alone does not unlock C7.

No acceptance obligation is waived by this freeze.
